content: Offline/vendor RCA packaging patterns: severity-ranked findings (error/warn), analysis overview filterable by severity, file inspector for drill-down, and prioritized executive summaries (OpenShift TSR AI upload). Evidence-first LLM paste guides prefer structured kubectl/events/describe plus short log tails, ranked hypotheses not definitive root cause, and explicit citation of source artifacts. Red Hat TSR is portal-upload SaaS; Troubleshoot local outcomes are message+severity oriented.
